# dispatch-two-builds-same's fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-dispatch-two-builds.yaml): the Dispatch
# server build-dispatch-build.sh makes of this tree as the previous build (its `go build` of
# ./cmd/dispatch reads this tree's module files), the Dispatch store's connections command its
# sizing step runs, and the modules of the twobuild-tagged tests of ./cmd/dispatch, which it runs
# against that build.
deps packages/envoy ./cmd/dispatch
deps packages/envoy ./internal/dispatch/store/cmd/connections
deps packages/envoy -test -tags twobuild ./cmd/dispatch
